plugin.name: Saved SQL
plugin.description: Write and save SQL, fill in :name parameters, run it read-only on a data source and read the result.
action.newHere: New SQL on this data source
field.source.hint: Empty: the environment's data source, then the default one.
error.noSource: No data source: pick one on the statement, in the environment, or set the default.
error.noResult: The data source returned no table.
error.param.number: The parameter :{name} must be a number.
error.param.date: The parameter :{name} must be a date (YYYY-MM-DD).
error.param.datetime: The parameter :{name} must be a date and time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, UTC).
error.param.enum: The parameter :{name} is not one of the allowed values.
error.param.max: The parameter :{name} is longer than {max} characters.
error.param.time: The parameter :{name} must be a time (HH:MM).
error.sourceMissingEnv: Data source “{source}” (from the environment) was not found. Pick another in the environment.
error.sourceMissingDefault: Data source “{source}” (the workspace default) was not found. Pick another in the workspace settings.
error.param.nul: The parameter :{name} contains a NUL character.
ai.missing: The AI workbench is not installed or cannot write SQL.
ai.noPreview: There is no request waiting to be sent.
ai.reviewFirst: The AI workbench made the request. Review it and send it there.
ai.proposalFrom: Proposed by {model}. Your editor has not changed.
ai.checkOk: Checked: one read-only statement. Press “Accept” to put it in the editor as an unsaved change.
ai.check.empty: Not acceptable: the answer is empty.
ai.check.multiple: Not acceptable: more than one statement.
ai.check.notSelect: Not acceptable: only SELECT or WITH is allowed.
ai.check.writes: Not acceptable: it contains a statement that changes data or structure.
ai.proposed: Proposal ready. Accept it to use it.
ai.proposedBad: The proposal did not pass the check and cannot be accepted.
ai.accepted: Put in the editor. Not saved yet.
ai.unavailable: Write with AI is not available: no AI workbench is installed.
ai.openReview: Open the request to review and send it
ai.notSentYet: Not sent yet. Open the request, read it and press Send there; then get the answer here.
ai.check.sideEffects: Not acceptable: it calls a function with side effects (PostgreSQL only is checked).
ai.preview: Not sent yet. Connection: {connection} · Model: {model} · about {tokens} tokens. Nothing leaves until you press Send in the AI workbench. No data is included.
